posts.title: Game Development and the Collapse of Civilization
posts.description: Today, I watched this great talk from DevGamm Moscow in 2019. Feels extremely relevant to the current theme of AI. Thank you Jonathan Blow! If you liked the historical discussion in the talk, do consider checking out “ Why the West Rules—For Now: The Patterns of History, and What They Reveal About the Future ” - Ian Morris (I haven’t read it myself but it came up in a related discussion).
